quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Yang Yong (Hubei listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing): the company's servers recently won China Mobile's 2026-2027 AI super-node centralized procurement, China Mobile's PC server centralized procurement and PICC Group's AI GPU core equipment procurement; its servers ship at scale in the operator market with a first-tier share, keep a leading share with operators and finance customers and have achieved a scale breakthrough with internet customers. He said operators' capex is shifting from communication networks toward compute infrastructure, while traditional optical transport capex is declining overall, and the company is pushing 50G PON and FTTR terminals to gain share.

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Yang Yong (collective 2025 results briefing): internationally the company added several large multinational operator customers, its pre-connectorized core products rank among the global leaders in sales scale (company claim), and its Thailand and Hungary R&D and manufacturing bases have formally started production, giving it 3 overseas production bases, 2 overseas R&D centers, 11 global delivery centers and more than 20 overseas offices, serving more than 100 countries and regions. Its optical module business focuses on coherent modules for long-haul transmission. In fiber and cable, where it has preform-fiber-cable integration, AI-driven data-center construction has changed industry supply and demand, and it is developing hollow-core, polarization-maintaining and radiation-resistant fiber. Its cumulative R&D over the past five years was nearly RMB two hundred hundred-million, an average R&D intensity above 12%.
